competence_gate: At least 12/20 physical stable successes on tuning and disjoint confirmation for each of three training seeds before a broad view/prior study. Threshold is an operational gate, not guaranteed performance.
selection: closed-loop stable placements, then selected lifts, then fewer collision episodes; offline loss is diagnostic only

stability.primary: physical stability after witnessed full-contained open-hand contact-free release; subsequent empty-hand closure does not reset object stability
stability.secondary: unchanged V2 strict composite requiring open fingers throughout dwell
